args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring specified ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py::test_half_even to fail in the
nightly build.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though the docstring (and `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. This caused the nightly build to fail.

## Change
Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Per FIN-212 and the failing nightly; requesting code-owner approval to merge into main for today's release.

transcript.reasoning_content: Fix: change ROUND_HALF_UP to ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Check: 2.675 quantize to 0.01 — Decimal quantize is exact decimal, so 2.675 → half-even → 2.68 (7 is odd, rounds up to 8? half-even rounds to even last digit: 2.67 vs 2.68 — 2.68 has even last digit 8, so → 2.68 ✓). 2.665 → 2.66 (6 even) ✓. So just change constant.
